title: Tuesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Stats for young kids
hook: Do you keep stats for your young players?
intro: A parent tracks hits and RBIs.
Kids start asking about their batting average.
statement: What gets counted is what kids start to chase.
q1: Do you track things like effort and good at-bats —
q2: or skip stats at this age entirely?
q3: What would you want them to chase?
t1: There is no single right way. But kids play freer
t2: when numbers do not define their game.
ctaLines: Good at-bats and effort. Hits only. No stats.
ctaPrompt: Share your habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Do you keep stats for your young players?
A parent tracks hits and RBIs. Kids start asking about their batting average.
What gets counted is what kids start to chase.
Track helpful stats or skip them. There is no perfect answer.
Do you keep stats? Share your habit in the comments.
